programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    separator = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, grid[separator][0])}
    upper = grid[:separator]
    lower = grid[separator + 1:]
    delta = {c: sum(v == c for row in lower for v in row) - sum(v == c for row in upper for v in row) for c in colors}
    color = max(colors, key=lambda c: delta[c])
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
'''
path=programs/'task-f58be651.py'
path.write_text(source)
